steps.meaning: The petition with at least 40 valid tenant signatures is filed with the board clerk before the hearing opens at 10:00 AM on Thursday 20 August 2026.
steps.name: petition_filed

steps.meaning: At least 40 valid tenant signatures have been collected and verified by the association.
steps.name: at_least_40_signatures_collected

steps.meaning: As of Monday 17 August, the association has 35 verified signatures (18 in Building 1, 11 in Building 2, 6 in Building 3).
steps.name: initial_35_signatures

steps.meaning: Dana Okoye canvasses Building 3 on Tuesday 18 August from 6:30 to 8:30 PM, collecting between 6 and 9 signatures.
steps.name: okoye_canvasses_tuesday
steps.uncertainty: Okoye may collect fewer than 6 or more than 9 signatures, but historical range is 6-9.

steps.meaning: Dana Okoye canvasses Building 3 on Wednesday 19 August from 6:30 to 8:30 PM, collecting between 6 and 9 signatures.
steps.name: okoye_canvasses_wednesday
steps.uncertainty: Okoye may collect fewer than 6 or more than 9 signatures, but historical range is 6-9.

steps.meaning: Superintendent Vic Morales posted the canvass notice on Building 3's lobby board at 5:00 PM on Monday 17 August, satisfying the 24-hour advance notice requirement.
steps.name: notice_posted

steps.meaning: Association secretary Lena Park files the petition at the hearing-room desk when it opens at 9:00 AM on Thursday 20 August, before the hearing opens at 10:00 AM.
steps.name: secretary_files_petition
steps.uncertainty: Park may be delayed or unable to file, but she has stated her intention and practice.
